summary:
Iteration 16 validated the Antidote reconnection fix in /app/frontend/src/lib/antidote.js. Frontend-only Playwright E2E against the live preview, mocking window.monExam and overriding window.WebSocket with a FakeWS that opens asynchronously and auto-closes 300ms after any 'LanceOutil' send (simulating Connectix closing after each tool session). All three scenarios PASSED.

Scenario 1 (RECONNECT, HIS301 redaction, antidote in allowed_tools):
- Joined HIS301 as student (no auth), passed PreCheck (forbiddenApps=[]), started exam, typed 'Bonjour les amis' in exam-rich-editor (ProseMirror).
- Click [exam-rich-editor-antidote-btn]: new ws://127.0.0.1:54321/ opened, LanceOutil Correcteur sent, success toast "Le correcteur Antidote s'ouvre avec votre texte..." shown. Socket closed by fake 300ms later; library's close handler sets estInitialise=false, websocket=undefined, calls sessionTerminee → antidote.js onSession resets current=null.
- Click [exam-rich-editor-antidote-guide-btn] (~700ms later): a NEW WebSocket to 127.0.0.1:54321 was opened (connectix count 1→2), LanceOutil Guides sent, toast 'Guides Antidote ouverts.' shown.
- Click [exam-rich-editor-antidote-dict-btn]: another NEW WebSocket (2→3), LanceOutil Dictionnaires sent, toast 'Dictionnaires Antidote ouverts.'.
- Final: connectix sockets=3, 3 distinct LanceOutil payloads, 3 success toasts. Fix verified: cached agent is dropped on close and agentFor transparently re-connects on next action.

Scenario failure 1 (antidotePort=0 → Connectix introuvable):
- Dict and Guides buttons still rendered (antidoteApiAvailable only checks for function presence) ✓.
- Click Corriger: both toasts appeared → error 'Antidote (Connectix) n'a pas répondu sur ce poste.' + fallback 'Texte sélectionné...' (Ctrl+C+C path). ✓
- Click Guides / Dict: each shows error 'Antidote (Connectix) n'a pas répondu sur ce poste.' ✓

Scenario failure 2 (port=54321 but WS never opens, dispatches 'error' at 100ms):
- Click Corriger: within ~130ms the error toast 'Antidote (Connectix) n'a pas répondu sur ce poste.' followed by fallback 'Texte sélectionné...' appeared. No silent hang. ✓ (well under the 5s SLA; library resolves on 'error' event via Gt onerror before the 2000ms timeout).

Code review notes on /app/frontend/src/lib/antidote.js:
- isReady() correctly unwraps both AgentConnectix (wrapper exposes impl) and raw impl; estInitialise is set true on WS open and false on close by the library (confirmed in fr.min.js: rouleWebSocket).
- agentFor() now re-invokes connecteAvecAntidote when !isReady, nulls cache + throws on persistent failure → calling code shows error toast + fallback. Matches the fix described.
- texteur.onSession = () => { if (current?.agent === agent) current=null } correctly guards against stale replacement when a new agent has already been swapped in.
- Minor: ferme() is called on editor change but swallowed with try/catch — fine. No file-size or DRY issues (file is 100 lines).
critical_code_review_comments: antidote.js: Fix correctly handles the three documented states (no port, open fails, socket closed after use). Reconnection confirmed by observing 3 distinct ws://127.0.0.1:54321/ constructor calls across 3 button clicks.
RichEditor.jsx: correct()/antidoteTool() catch blocks produce user-visible toasts; the fallback 'Texte sélectionné' toast is intentionally shown after the error toast on Corriger failure (good UX).

antidote-api-js (library) closes-handler: resets estInitialise=false, websocket=undefined and invokes agentTexteur.sessionTerminee(); the fix relies on this handler firing — behavior confirmed via the FakeWS 'close' event.

seed_data_creation: Each run creates a student session named 'TEST AntidoteReco*' / 'TEST AntiFail*' on HIS301; harmless, same as prior iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For reproducing Antidote WS behaviour under Playwright, the FakeWS override MUST (a) extend EventTarget AND set this.onopen/onclose/onerror directly (library uses both patterns via Gt helper), (b) match 'LanceOutil' (not '\"message\":\"LanceOutil\"' which is double-escaped inside the outer JSON packet), and (c) dispatch close ONLY for ws://127.0.0.1:54321 to avoid closing the backend /ws socket which is also routed through the override. HIS301 exam id=9eff4a26-2f0a-4333-afd2-a6dc588c0c1d, redaction, allowed_tools includes antidote. RichEditor testId for exam essay is 'exam-rich-editor'; Antidote buttons are '{testId}-antidote-btn', '{testId}-antidote-guide-btn', '{testId}-antidote-dict-btn'. ProseMirror is the element with data-testid itself (not a child).
rca of the issue: Original bug: antidote.js kept `current` cached indefinitely. When Connectix closes the socket after a tool session (library sets estInitialise=false, websocket=undefined, fires sessionTerminee), subsequent clicks called lanceGuides/lanceDictionnaires/lanceCorrecteur which internally short-circuit with 'if(this.estInitialise){...}' → silent no-op. Fix calls connecteAvecAntidote when !isReady (which runs demarreWS since this.websocket is undefined), nulls the cache on sessionTerminee, and throws if reconnection fails so the UI shows a toast instead of nothing.
